title: Russian Carrot Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish made with blanched dumplings filled with a savory carrot mixture. Serve with a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: Boil a large pot of salted water.
Add the dumplings to the boiling water and cook for 5-7 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, chop the carrots into small pieces.
In a pan, heat 1 tsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped carrots to the pan and cook until tender.
Mix in the savory light seasoning.
Once the dumplings are done cooking, drain them and add to a serving dish.
Spoon the carrot mixture over the top of the dumplings.
